name: Axioma Lexis
tagline: Adaptive Spaced Repetition Vocabulary & Flashcards for Android
description: A 100% free, local-first vocabulary memorization workspace mirroring and elevating Mem-App. Features progressive dictionary search, US/UK speech pronunciation, adaptive SM-2 spaced repetition flashcards, and functorial undo/redo.
target_persona: Intermediate+ English Vocabulary Learner (Android Mobile User)
ergonomic_goals: Zero cognitive friction: 1-tap add to deck directly from dictionary search.
Mobile-first touch ergonomics: thumb-reach bottom nav bar and large touch targets.
Native speech audio pronunciation in both American (en-US) and British (en-GB) English.
Lossless Functorial Undo (Cmd+Z or 1-tap Undo) to reverse accidental flashcard ratings without state corruption.
Installable as native Progressive Web App (PWA) on Android Chrome without Google Play Store locks.
100% free to use forever with zero paid subscription tiers or API paywalls.
